element operator | person | Operator |  | Starts the skills with slash commands, watches the worker runs in the progress panes, and answers the questions of the agents.
element agent | person | Coding agent |  | A Claude Code or Codex session that loads the skill plugins, follows a skill step by step, and runs the tools and the fleet CLIs that it names.
element bifrost | softwareSystem | Bifröst |  | The skills layer of the 21Stark fleet: 30 skills in seven Claude Code plugins, the TypeScript tools that they call, two hooks and four mods, served from source as a Claude Code marketplace.
element alfred | externalSystem | alfred |  | The ticket CLI of the fleet: binds a ticket to a session, and reads, files and moves the ClickUp tickets.
element hermod | externalSystem | Hermod |  | Places the tabs of the agents in cmux, carries their messages, and closes the tabs.
element idun | externalSystem | idun |  | Holds njord, which opens and merges the PRs, and valkyrie, which launches the Gru, Minion and Agnes workers.
element urd | externalSystem | urd |  | The local registry of the fleet: tells a launcher the folder of each repo on the Mac.
element muninn | externalSystem | muninn |  | Carries messages between agents. A Gru with a muninn leader reports to the chief of odin through it.
element frigg | externalSystem | frigg |  | The vendor CLI of the fleet: reads and writes the EI tickets in the Jira of Evinced.
element atlas | externalSystem | Atlas |  | The second-brain engine. Its brain adr commands record and supersede the ADRs of a repo.
element heimdall | externalSystem | Heimdall |  | Sends a push from the Mac to the iPhone, the iPad and the Watch of the operator.
element nastrond | externalSystem | Náströnd |  | The code graveyard of the fleet: a git repo that keeps the retired code, one row for each burial in its index.
element floorplan | externalSystem | floorplan |  | Keeps the C4 model of each product as LikeC4 text, builds its views, and shows the proposals in its studio.
element sleipnir | externalSystem | Sleipnir |  | Drives Chrome for agents. Its Huginn route draws boxes with questions on a page of the operator.
element github | externalSystem | GitHub |  | Hosts the repos, the PRs, the reviews and the releases, and serves this repo as the plugin marketplace.
element aiClis | externalSystem | Review agent CLIs |  | The claude, codex and gemini CLIs, which run headless as reviewers, as a jury, or as a test of a skill description.
element ecosystemVault | externalSystem | Ecosystem vault |  | The vault of the fleet facts that every session reads. Its entity folders name the repos of the fleet.
element bifrost.skills | container | Skill plugins | Markdown, Claude Code plugins | Hold the procedures that a coding agent follows: tickets, specs, builds, reviews, sessions, releases, the Gru, Minion and Agnes workers, and the docs, writing and design skills. Claude Code installs them from the marketplace manifest; Codex reads the same tree.
element bifrost.dispatchers | container | Review dispatchers | TypeScript, Node.js 24 | iac_review, refactor_planner and jury start Claude, Codex and Gemini as headless subprocesses with a scrubbed environment, then parse and merge their output. preflight checks the agents and the logins first.
element bifrost.reviewPoster | container | Review poster | TypeScript, Node.js 24 | Posts the findings of a code review on a PR as one review: inline where the anchor is in the diff, in the body otherwise, and never twice.
element bifrost.buildTools | container | Build tools | TypeScript, Node.js 24 | copilot_land pushes the branch of a build and opens or adopts its PR, validation_gate runs the checks of a repo, and approach_contract and github_projects support the build.
element bifrost.sessionTools | container | Session tools | TypeScript, Node.js 24 | stark_session opens and closes a session with its health checks and briefing; stark_handover, session_state, context_compactor and stark_persona keep its state; self_healer and healer_canary fix known failures; asset_links installs the checkout links.
element bifrost.docTools | container | Agent-doc tools | TypeScript, Node.js 24 | rules_audit triages the agent instruction files clause by clause, memory_tidy tidies the auto-memory, ask_guard_metric counts the turns that end on a question, and the skill tools audit and tune the skills.
element bifrost.releaseTools | container | Release tools | TypeScript, Node.js 24 | release_changelog drafts the changelog of a release from the git history, and release_version_bump picks and writes the next version.
element bifrost.gateHook | container | Agent-doc gate hook | TypeScript, Node.js 24, PreToolUse hook | Runs before each njord pr-merge call, triages the agent files that the PR changes, and denies the merge only on a RED clause that the PR adds.
element bifrost.factHook | container | Fact routing hook | TypeScript, Node.js 24, PostToolUse hook | Runs after each write to an auto-memory file, and tells the session when the fact may belong in the ecosystem vault instead.
element bifrost.progressMod | container | stark-progress mod | TypeScript, Claude Code mod | Shows the Gru pane and the ticket pane beside the chat: the board of a run, its log in plain words, its stats, and the settings that the workers read before a review, a merge or a release.
element bifrost.questionMods | container | Question mods | TypeScript, Claude Code mods | needs-you shows the Needs you lines of a turn in a band above the prompt; decision-deck and interview give the agent the present and ask tools, and show the questions in a pane.
element bifrost.progressFiles | database | Progress files | JSON and JSON Lines files | The ticket, run, log and settings files in ~/.cache/stark-progress: the state contract between the worker skills and the stark-progress mod.
element bifrost.toolState | database | Tool state | JSON and JSON Lines files | The session files, the handovers, the healer log, the jury runs and the ask-guard log in ~/.claude/code-review, outside the plugin cache, so that they outlive an update.
